title: The desktop sidebar's last link sat outside its own panel and below the fold at 1440x844 (fixed)
detail: Found while diagnosing a pipeline-wide browser-check failure. At 1440x844 the last sidebar item, the .sidebar-repo link ('Open-source & auditable'), was painted at y=860-875 while the fixed sidebar ended at y=844, so the link was outside the painted navy panel, unreachable by pointer, and reported by axe as 2.23:1 against the page background (#96aab8 on #f4f7f8) instead of about 6.4:1 against the sidebar. The defect is layout, not colour: the sidebar's children overflowed its fixed height. Session arena-ca4d2a02 reached the same conclusion independently and its fix is the one merged on main (c536501: overflow-y:auto, .sidebar-repo colour #b9c9d3, and a max-height:920px compaction block). This session keeps that fix, adds overscroll-behavior:contain so the sidebar cannot scroll the page behind it, and pins the behaviour in tests/browser/sidebar_fit.spec.mjs: at 1440x844, 1024x844 and 768x844 the last sidebar link must sit inside the sidebar and above the fold, and shorter viewports must scroll the sidebar instead of clipping it. Measured in Chromium at those widths; screenshots are not stored in the repository.

title: 193 of 200 recent checks runs failed and the browser step never named the failing test
detail: Between 2026-10-22T07:47Z and 10:17Z the Validate dashboard workflow recorded 7 successes and 193 failures across every session's branch; every failure after 08:27:50Z reported only 'Process completed with exit code 1' for the Playwright step, and this environment cannot download job logs (they are served from productionresultssa*.blob.core.windows.net and results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com, both unreachable). The Python step already published its failures as annotations; the browser step did not. New scripts/playwright-annotations.mjs (registered in playwright.config.mjs) prints one ::error per failing test with the assertion diff, which named the seven 1440px contrast tests on run 39762907867. A second, unrelated cause of a red PR check is recorded too: the pull_request job for commit 5cc2673 was cancelled at exactly 30m13s by the job cap while the same commit passed the push-triggered job in 25m52s, so the cap was raised to 45 minutes.
